summary.headline: P&G Health FY26 sales rose 16% to close to ₹1,400 crore and PAT rose 30% to ₹327 crore, with volume growth at mid-single digits.
summary.overview: Management presented FY26 (12 months to March 31, 2026) results: sales of close to ₹1,400 crore (up 16%) and PAT of ₹327 crore (up 30%). Growth was attributed to the Integrated Growth Strategy, three FY26 innovations (Livogen Iron Gummies, Neurobion Nerve Pain Relief Cream, Evion L5000), and expanded pharmacy coverage of about 30,000 added pharmacies and HCPs. Over five years, sales grew about 1.4X and profit about 1.8X, with average sales growth in the high single digits and average profit growth of 13%. Management declined to give forward guidance, FY27 launch details, or a margin target.

segments.name: Neurobion and Livogen
segments.commentary: Grew around 20% in FY26, helped by Big-B and 12-Ka-Naara campaigns and new innovations. Neurobion Alfa D has grown at a high double digit CAGR since its 2021 launch.

segments.name: Seven Seas
segments.commentary: Grew at early double digits in FY26.

segments.name: Nasivion and Evion
segments.commentary: Each grew at high single digits in FY26. Management separately acknowledged IQVIA-indicated de-growth in Evion and Polybion, without quantifying it.

segments.name: Exports
segments.commentary: Recovered in FY26. Nepal grew 3X and Sri Lanka grew high single digits, supported by Neurobion Forte and Evion Forte launches. Export volume and price split was not disclosed.

segments.name: FY26 innovations (combined)
segments.commentary: Livogen Iron Gummies, Neurobion Nerve Pain Relief Cream and Evion L5000 together contributed early single-digit percentage points to growth.

guidance_outlook: No forward guidance given on sales, volume, EBITDA margin or FY27 launch revenue; management cited the need to refrain from forward-looking estimates.
Management said it is 'poised for growth in the near term' and expects growth 'on both volume and value', without numbers.
Management said the portfolio is well positioned for the VMS category, with preventive health and e-pharmacy trends as tailwinds.
Gross margin improvement in FY26 was attributed to productivity, favorable product mix and pricing within NPPA limits; no margin target was stated.
Management said it will take a balanced approach between investing in SG&A and maintaining margins.
capex_capacity: No capacity, utilisation, capex or commissioning figures were discussed in the call.
Go-to-market expansion: about 30,000 pharmacies and HCPs added to coverage over 2-3 years, focused on extra-urban white space.
Medically trained sales force has educated nearly 1 lakh HCPs on Neurobion Nerve Pain Relief Cream.
demand_pricing: Pricing: management cited the NPPA norm allowing up to 10% price increase for non-scheduled drugs in a rolling 12 months, and WPI-linked increases for scheduled drugs. Management did not disclose the FY26 price vs volume split.
Volume growth FY26 was mid-single digits, which implies most of the 16% sales growth came from price/mix and other factors. This is an inference from the stated figures, not a management statement.
Livogen Iron Gummies reached the highest category share on Amazon and ranked #1 in iron gummies there; it recorded double HCP conversions.
Evion L5000 added an incremental prescription share of early single digits in FY26. Evion LC prescriptions were cited by an analyst as increasing.

Pharmacy reach: management did not give an absolute count and said coverage is 'thousands' of pharmacies. A prior reference point of about 3 lakh pharmacies was raised by an analyst, against India's 8-9 lakh total.
Competition: management said it is gaining market share in a dynamic VMS segment, without quantifying share.

qa_highlights.question: Name new products planned for FY27 and their expected revenue contribution.
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to name upcoming launches or give revenue estimates; it said the three FY26 launches exceeded expectations and added early single-digit growth points.

qa_highlights.question: What were the annual price hikes for FY26 and the last three years, and what was the price vs volume split?
qa_highlights.answer: Management did not disclose annual price hikes or the split. It cited NPPA norms (up to 10% for non-scheduled drugs) and said FY26 volume grew at mid-single digits.

qa_highlights.question: What EBITDA margin is targeted for FY27 and over 3-5 years, and is the ~36% margin sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: No margin target was given. Management said FY26 gross margin gains came from productivity, product mix and pricing; productivity savings were ₹35 crore; SG&A would be reinvested in advertising and retail execution.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 16% sales growth and recent quarterly momentum sustainable, and can volume grow faster than industry?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is confident of continued momentum from superiority, innovation and productivity, but gave no numbers or forward guidance.

qa_highlights.question: Does GLP-1 adoption create an opportunity, and how is the competitive environment evolving?
qa_highlights.answer: Management called GLP-1 a complementary opportunity, since VMS supports nutritional needs alongside GLP-1 treatments. It said it is gaining market share, without quantifying it.

qa_highlights.question: How has the GTM change expanded distribution, and is reaching 5-6 lakh pharmacies in three years a stretch?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it added about 30,000 pharmacies and HCPs in extra-urban areas over 2-3 years and gave no absolute count or target for 5-6 lakh pharmacies.

qa_highlights.question: What is the export growth driver and is it sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: Exports grew in FY26, with Nepal at 3X and Sri Lanka at high single digits, driven by consumption, availability, detailing and launches such as Neurobion Forte and Evion Forte. No export figure in rupees was given.

risks_watch: No forward guidance was given, so FY27 growth and margin expectations cannot be anchored to company figures.
Price-led growth is capped by NPPA norms; the FY26 volume at mid-single digits suggests reliance on pricing for much of the 16% growth.
IQVIA-indicated de-growth in Evion and Polybion in FY26 was acknowledged but not explained; watch whether these brands recover.
Gross margin and EBITDA sustainability: an analyst referenced a 36% EBITDA margin and asked if spending on new launches would bring it back to 28%; management did not respond on that number.
Track the FY26 launches' revenue contribution, pharmacy coverage numbers and e-commerce share, which were not disclosed quantitatively.
Export growth durability beyond the low base (Nepal 3X) was not quantified.
summary.management_tone: Confident on past performance and strategy, but evasive on forward-looking items. Management repeatedly declined to give FY27 launch names, revenue contribution, margin targets or volume guidance, citing disclosure reasons, and fell back on general 'Integrated Growth Strategy' language.
key_quotes: We delivered a strong year with consistent top-line and bottom-line growth.
These launches have exceeded our expectations!
we have recorded a balanced volume growth at mid-single digits in FY 2526.
we are gaining market share due to our relentless focus on product superiority, strong brand equity, and deep understanding of consumer and patient needs.

growth.why: No numeric forward guidance; management said it is 'poised for growth in the near term' on volume and value, backed only by the 30,000-pharmacy go-to-market expansion and FY26 innovations with no capacity, order or revenue figures attached.
